children: Artisan Partners Asset Management entered a new $150 million five-year revolving credit facility led by Bank of America as administrative agent, maturing on September 23, 2031, with the option to increase total commitments up to $225 million. Pricing is tied to leverage, with borrowings bearing interest at Term SOFR or a base rate plus applicable margins. In connection with the new facility, the company terminated its $100 million revolving credit agreement dated August 16, 2022 with Citibank; there were no outstanding borrowings at termination. The refinancing enhances liquidity and extends the company’s debt maturities.
